review:
Part three ditches the Bonanza layout for cluster pays: five or more connected symbols win. Random spin modifiers can fire in the base game to shake things up.

The bonus, Cosmo Frenzy, has a progress bar with five levels – each one needs more points and comes with a bigger multiplier: 2x, 4x, 6x, 8x and finally 10x – and all five spin modifiers are assured at every level. Oddly for this series it's rated medium-high rather than very high, with a 10,000x cap and 97% RTP. Bonus roughly once every 196 spins. The smoothest of the three games.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
